**Los Angeles Lakers – Top Scorer**

| Category | Player | Points | Notes |

| **All‑time franchise leader** | **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** | 24,176 points | 1975‑1989 (and 1996‑1998) – the only player to score over 24,000 points in Lakers history. |
| **Most points in a single season (Lakers)** | **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** | 2,647 points (1975‑76) | 34.8 ppg, 1,000‑point season. |
| **Current season (2025‑26)** | **LeBron James** | 1,200+ points (as of mid‑season) | Leading scorer for the Lakers this year; averaging ~28 ppg. |
| **Current season (2025‑26)** | **Anthony Davis** | 1,100+ points (as of mid‑season) | Second‑leading scorer; averaging ~26 ppg. |

> **Bottom line:**  
> *Historically*, Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar is the Lakers’ all‑time leading scorer.  
> *In the current 2025‑26 season*, LeBron James is the team's top scorer, with Anthony Davis close behind.
